requirements.name: 操舵の回転を折って伝える所の、1 か所あたりの折れ角の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the maximum operating angle of one maker's single steering universal joints, applied to the joints of this vehicle, whose maker is not chosen. Borgeson Universal, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" (sheet dated 3/20/2018), item 1): single joints 35 degrees, double joints 70 degrees, beyond which the joint can bind and be damaged; read 2026-11-06 (https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). These are aftermarket steering joints of cars. Industrial joints are rated otherwise (read 2026-11-06): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 8, needle roller T series 40 deg single, 80 deg double; PDF p. 9, plain bearing DIN 808 joints 45 deg single, 90 deg double; PDF p. 6, plain T series sizes 50 and up 30 deg (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); Timken NB10-UJ needle bearing type, max operating angle for power transmission 25 deg (https://cad.timken.com/printitem/needle-bearing-type-universal-joints/eedle-bearing-type-universal-solid-joints-imperial/68514415607). Borgeson's web page (https://www.borgeson.com/joints.html) was not checked (403). The joint actually chosen and its catalogue win over this value

requirements.name: ハンドルから車輪の側へ伝わる回転のむらの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the example value of an allowable torque variation rate in a passenger-car steering design tool, applied to this vehicle. NSK Ltd, US 8,965,743 B2 (granted 2015-02-24), description of FIG. 21-27: the allowable torque variation rate is "for example, 10%" (FIG. 23-27 compare 10 % down to 3 %); the torque variation rate is the ratio of input to output torque, the inverse of the angular velocity ratio (its Equation (5) is an image and was not read); read 2026-11-06 in the Google Patents text (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). HIRAKU takes the rate as the largest deviation of the output-to-input speed ratio from 1 over one turn (an assumption about the patent's definition). The ratio of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a) (a = angle between the shafts, t = turn of the input from the position where its arm of the cross lies in the plane of the two shafts), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary) (https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); the same range w cos a to w sec a in Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. No standard for steering was read

load_cases.title: 土の地面で横転: 傾斜台を倒れる角度より先まで傾けて車を床に落とし、ロールバーと骨組みが乗員の空間に入らないか (HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない。手計算は OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる: 横 875 J・後ろ 700 J・上 10 kN、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: R4: in a rollover (the tilt table past the angle the vehicle tips at; it falls onto the floor and lands on its roll bar) no frame member enters the occupants' space; the smallest gap over the landing between the frame's members (the roll bar and the rest) and the space of k4_geometry.occupant_spaces (the occupant box, widened to AIST D2 and raised to AIST I1 of a young male 95th percentile) stays at 0 mm or more. HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない. OECD Code 4 (2.1: tractors of at least 600 kg, as read on 2026-11-03, the 600 kg not in README's table of checked values) and ISO 3471 (about 700 kg and up: 確かめていない) are static tests for machines of 600-700 kg and up; whether ANSI/ROHVA 1 has a dynamic test was not checked. Code 4 (3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2) stops its static loading at the same space; its loads are the hand calculation's, and R4's 10 kN from above (Code 4's 20 N/kg at the reference mass 500 kg gives 10 kN) is 「HIRAKU の仮定」. The ground is a soil: 1000 N/mm per contact point (地面の硬さは HIRAKU の仮定。土と舗装の 2 通り; R4-rollover-pavement is the same on a pavement)

load_cases.title: 舗装の地面で横転: 傾斜台を倒れる角度より先まで傾けて車を床に落とし、ロールバーと骨組みが乗員の空間に入らないか (HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない。手計算は OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる: 横 875 J・後ろ 700 J・上 10 kN、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: R4: in a rollover (the tilt table past the angle the vehicle tips at; it falls onto the floor and lands on its roll bar) no frame member enters the occupants' space; the smallest gap over the landing between the frame's members (the roll bar and the rest) and the space of k4_geometry.occupant_spaces (the occupant box, widened to AIST D2 and raised to AIST I1 of a young male 95th percentile) stays at 0 mm or more. HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない. OECD Code 4 (2.1: tractors of at least 600 kg, as read on 2026-11-03, the 600 kg not in README's table of checked values) and ISO 3471 (about 700 kg and up: 確かめていない) are static tests for machines of 600-700 kg and up; whether ANSI/ROHVA 1 has a dynamic test was not checked. Code 4 (3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2) stops its static loading at the same space; its loads are the hand calculation's, and R4's 10 kN from above (Code 4's 20 N/kg at the reference mass 500 kg gives 10 kN) is 「HIRAKU の仮定」. The ground is a pavement: 100000 N/mm per contact point, near rigid (地面の硬さは HIRAKU の仮定。土と舗装の 2 通り; R4-rollover is the same on a soil)

Q93, Q94, Q96: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption); Q95: AIST sitting height I1, young men 95th percentile, as the intake department read it (an assumption). A net held only by quick-release clips and a door with hinges and a latch open (Q47: opened by hand with one hand in one action, CPSC's proposed rule's preamble applied to opening, an assumption) and are not counted

checks.case_ja: 四辺を単純支持した正方形の板 100 x 100 x 1、一様な圧力 0.01 MPa、メッシュ 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.source_ja: いちばん細かい 2 段のあいだの変化が限度の 5 % より小さく、応力が限りなく大きくなる点 (特異点) でもない

checks.case: simply supported square plate 100 x 100 x 1, uniform 0.01 MPa, meshes 4 x 4 / 8 x 8 / 16 x 16
checks.quantity: error estimate falls with each refinement (finest / coarsest, global %)
checks.source: the Zienkiewicz-Zhu estimate of constant-stress elements on a smooth field falls as h^1 (halves per halving); got 37.2 / 17.1 / 8.3 %. Expectation from the element's order, tolerance HIRAKU's choice

checks.source: the singular point is the corner

checks.source_ja: 応力が限りなく大きくなる点 (特異点) は入り隅の角

checks.case: L-shaped plate 200 x 200 without a 100 x 100 corner, tension on both arms, meshes 8 / 16 / 32 elements per 100 mm
checks.source: values growing with d2/d1 at or above 2^-0.5 are singular (k1_shell.convergence); the corner has no finite stress
checks.case_ja: L 字の板 (200 x 200 から 100 x 100 の角を切り取った形)、両方の腕を引っぱる、メッシュは 100 mm あたり 8 / 16 / 32 要素

checks.case: L-shaped plate 200 x 200 without a 100 x 100 corner, tension on both arms, meshes 8 / 16 / 32 elements per 100 mm
checks.quantity: growth of the corner peak per halving (d2 / d1)
checks.source: re-entrant corner of 270 degrees in plane stress: the stress grows as r^(lambda - 1) with lambda the smallest root of lambda sin(2 alpha) + sin(2 alpha lambda) = 0, 2 alpha = 3 pi / 2 (symmetric mode; M. L. Williams, J. Appl. Mech. 19 (1952) 526-528, not checked here; the root is found here), so the corner element's value grows by 2^(1 - lambda) each time the elements halve; lambda 0.5445
checks.case_ja: L 字の板 (200 x 200 から 100 x 100 の角を切り取った形)、両方の腕を引っぱる、メッシュは 100 mm あたり 8 / 16 / 32 要素
checks.source_ja: 平面応力で 270° の入り隅: 応力は r^(λ - 1) で大きくなる。λ は λ sin(2α) + sin(2α λ) = 0、2α = 3π/2 のいちばん小さい根 (対称のモード。根はここで求める。M. L. Williams, J. Appl. Mech. 19 (1952) 526-528、確かめていない)。なので要素を半分にするたびに、角の要素の値は 2^(1 - λ) 倍になる。λ = 0.5445

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: combined slip, kappa -1..1 and alpha -55..55 deg: largest hypot(Fx/Dx, Fy/Dy)
checks.source: the friction ellipse of the pure-slip peaks; the combined-slip weighting is a fit, so 5 % over is allowed
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 前後と横に同時に滑らせたとき (前後の滑り -1〜1、横滑りの角度 -55〜55°)、力が摩擦の楕円の外に出ないか
checks.source_ja: 前後だけ・横だけのときのいちばん大きい力で作る摩擦の楕円。同時に滑るときの式は測定に合わせた形なので、5 % まで外に出てよい

checks.case: Magic Formula tyre of the check vehicle's FL wheel at its static load 1422 N, mu 0.8: aligning moment at alpha +2 deg and -2 deg turns the wheel toward its motion (Mz(+2) > 0 > Mz(-2))
checks.source: ISO signs: positive alpha slides the contact to the left, and the moment turns the heading that way
checks.case_ja: 確かめ用の車の左前輪のタイヤ (Magic Formula、止まっているときの荷重 1422 N、摩擦係数 0.8): 横滑りの角度 +2° と -2° で、タイヤを戻す回る力が、進む向きにタイヤを向けるか
checks.source_ja: ISO の符号の決まり: 横滑りの角度が + なら接地点は左に滑り、回る力はタイヤをその向きに回す

checks.case: stiff wheel r = 300 mm on a 100 mm step
checks.source: rigid wheel on a step corner: d = sqrt(2 r h - h^2), F/W = d / (r - h)
checks.case_ja: 硬い輪 (半径 300 mm) が 100 mm の段差に乗り上がり始めるときの、押す力 / 輪の荷重
checks.source_ja: 段差の角に当たった硬い輪: 角までの前後の距離 d = √(2 r h - h²)、押す力 / 荷重 = d / (r - h)

checks.case: both front wheels on a 100 mm step, pushed by the rear: front axle load at lift-off
checks.source: moment balance with the push at axle height: W_f = m g (L - a) / L / (1 + k r / L)
checks.case_ja: 前の 2 輪が 100 mm の段差に当たり、後ろから押されて浮く瞬間の、前の車軸の荷重
checks.source_ja: 車軸の高さで押されるときの回る力のつり合い: 前の荷重 = 車の重さ × (L - a) / L / (1 + 押す力の比 × 輪の半径 / L)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): peak wall force
checks.source: undamped mass-spring impact: F = v sqrt(k m), m with a third of the tube's mass
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 壁の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない質量とばねの衝突: F = v √(k m) (m にはパイプの重さの 1/3 を足す)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): contact time
checks.source: half a period of the mass on the spring: pi sqrt(m / k)
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 壁に触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 質量とばねの揺れの半周期 π √(m / k)

checks.case: 2000 kg on a 0.5 m elastic 40x40x2.3 tube hits the wall at 1 m/s (k = E A / L in series with the wall's penalty spring, 107.7 kN/mm): speed change of the whole mass (momentum change / mass) = the wall's impulse / mass
checks.source: Newton's second law over the run: the beams' internal forces cancel
checks.case_ja: 弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) の後ろに 2000 kg を載せ、1 m/s で壁に当てる (ばね = パイプの E A / L と壁の押し返しのばねの直列、107.7 kN/mm): 全体の運動量の変わり (全体の重さで割って速さの変わりにした) が、壁から受けた力積と同じか
checks.source_ja: 運動の法則: 梁の中の力は打ち消し合うので、運動量を変えるのは壁の力だけ

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): peak contact force
checks.source: undamped impact of two masses through a spring: F = v sqrt(k mu), mu the reduced mass (each with a third of its tube)
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 接触の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない 2 つの質量のばねを介した衝突: F = v √(k μ) (μ は換算質量)

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): contact time
checks.source: half a period: pi sqrt(mu / k)
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 半周期 π √(μ / k)

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): speed of the struck tube after
checks.source: elastic impact (momentum and energy kept): v2' = 2 M1 / (M1 + M2) v
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 当てられた側の、離れたあとの速さ
checks.source_ja: 弾性衝突 (運動量とエネルギーが保たれる): v2' = 2 M1 / (M1 + M2) v

checks.case: two elastic 40x40x2.3 tubes 0.5 m long, not joined, on one axis: 2000 kg behind the moving one (1 m/s), 1000 kg behind the other at rest; no wall (springs in series: each tube's E A / L and the contact's penalty spring, 9.6 kN/mm): the total momentum after / before
checks.source: the contact forces are equal and opposite: the momentum is kept
checks.case_ja: つながっていない弾性の角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.5 m) 2 本を同じ軸に並べ、後ろに 2000 kg を載せた片方を 1 m/s で止まっているもう片方 (後ろに 1000 kg) に当てる (壁なし。ばね = 2 本の E A / L と接触の押し返しのばねの直列、9.6 kN/mm): 全体の運動量の、後と前の比
checks.source_ja: 接触の力は向きが反対で大きさが同じなので、運動量は保たれる

checks.case: a 40x40x2.3 tube 0.6 m long moving at 2 m/s crosswise onto another at rest (no gravity): the least distance between the axes (the contact radii sum to 40 mm; the penetration bound 0.34 mm)
checks.source: all the relative kinetic energy in the contact spring at most: penetration <= v sqrt(mu / k), k the contact's penalty spring at the middles
checks.case_ja: 角パイプ (40×40×2.3、長さ 0.6 m) を、止まっているもう 1 本の上に 2 m/s で十字に落とす (重力なし): 2 本の軸のいちばん近い距離 (接触の半径の和からのめり込みが上限 0.34 mm 以内か)
checks.source_ja: 相対の運動エネルギーが全部接触のばねに入っても、めり込みは v √(μ / k) まで

checks.case: a wheel node (18 kg, radius 0.3 m, tyre 60 N/mm, section height 120 mm) moving at 1 m/s into the wall (the rim does not reach it): peak wall force
checks.source: undamped mass-spring impact: F = v sqrt(k_t m)
checks.case_ja: 車輪の点 (18 kg、半径 0.3 m、タイヤのばね 60 N/mm、タイヤの断面の高さ 120 mm) を 1 m/s で壁に当てる (リムは壁に届かない): 壁の力のいちばん大きい値
checks.source_ja: 減衰のない質量とばねの衝突: F = v √(k_t m)

checks.case: a wheel node (18 kg, radius 0.3 m, tyre 60 N/mm, section height 120 mm) moving at 1 m/s into the wall (the rim does not reach it): contact time
checks.source: half a period of the mass on the tyre's spring: pi sqrt(m / k_t)
checks.case_ja: 車輪の点 (18 kg、半径 0.3 m、タイヤのばね 60 N/mm、タイヤの断面の高さ 120 mm) を 1 m/s で壁に当てる (リムは壁に届かない): 壁に触れている時間
checks.source_ja: 質量とばねの揺れの半周期 π √(m / k_t)

checks.case: the same wheel node at 40 km/h (the free tyre would deflect 192 mm, more than its section height): the deepest x of the node
checks.source: the rim (radius r - section height) reaches the wall and stops there, perfectly plastic: x = wall - (r - h)
checks.case_ja: 同じ車輪の点を 40 km/h で当てる (タイヤのたわみが断面の高さを超える): 点がいちばん進んだ x
checks.source_ja: リム (半径 = r - タイヤの断面の高さ) が壁に届いたらそこで止まる (跳ね返らない): x = 壁 - (r - h)

data.want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両を作りたい。電池で走る 4 輪で、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg。横転しても、乗っている人を守りたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.basis: 気象庁「風の強さと吹き方」https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/know/yougo_hp/kazehyo.html (the table is an image, kazehyo.png and kazehyo.pdf): 平均風速 20 m/s is where 「非常に強い風」 begins; 注 2: the gust is often about 1.5 times the mean wind (3 times or more when the air is unstable). So a gust of 30 m/s (1.5 x 20 m/s) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer, dust and splashing water on a forest road)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 動かして操作する仕組みと配線の隙間の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 dd (mechanical control cables) and 11-125 (movable controls): at least 1/2 in (= 12.7 mm, computed) between wiring and the controls when the bundle is pushed with light hand pressure toward them, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める高さの下限 (座席の基準点から、胴の線に沿って上へ)
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (MLIT English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf), para. 5.6.2 and 5.6.3.1 (front seats not less than 800 mm, other seats 750 mm) and para. 6.5.4 (the height is from the R point, the seating reference point of para. 2.13, to the tangent at the top, measured along the manikin's torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; R17 applies to M1 and N1 (para. 1). 49 CFR 571.202a (FMVSS 202a, eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a) S4.2.1(a)(1) (front outboard not less than 800 mm in at least one position) with S3 (height from the H-point parallel to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; it applies to passenger cars and to MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R25 was not checked (not reachable). No text read requires this for an off-road utility or recreational vehicle; ANSI/ROHVA 1, ANSI/OPEI B71.9 and SAE J2258 were not checked

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める面の左右の幅の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.11 (not less than 85 mm to each side of the seat's vertical median plane; 2 x 85 = 170 mm computed) and para. 6.6.1 (measured in a plane 65 mm below the top, perpendicular to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.2 (not less than 170 mm at 65 ±3 mm below the top; 254 mm for a front outboard seat when a front centre seat exists), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles (S2)

requirements.name: 頭の後ろと、それを受け止める面との前後のすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a US passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.3 (front outboard backset not more than 55 mm) with S3 (backset = the minimum horizontal distance from the rear of the head of a seated 50th percentile male, head restraint measurement device on the SAE J826 manikin, to the head restraint) and S5.2.3 (top set between 750 and 800 mm, seat back at the design angle), eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a, read 2026-11-06; applies to passenger cars and MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R17 08 series has no backset limit (the word does not occur in the MLIT text, read 2026-11-06); later R17 series and UN R25 were not checked

requirements.name: 背もたれと、頭を受け止める部分のあいだのすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.8 (no gap of more than 60 mm between the seat back and a head restraint not adjustable for height; 25 mm in the lowest position if adjustable) and para. 6.7.1 (gaps measured with a 165 mm sphere), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.4.1 (no gap greater than 60 mm with a 165 mm sphere), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.basis: assumption: the maximum operating angle of one maker's single steering universal joints, applied to the joints of this vehicle, whose maker is not chosen. Borgeson Universal, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" (sheet dated 3/20/2018), item 1): single joints 35 degrees, double joints 70 degrees, beyond which the joint can bind and be damaged; read 2026-11-06 (https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). These are aftermarket steering joints of cars. Industrial joints are rated otherwise (read 2026-11-06): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 8, needle roller T series 40 deg single, 80 deg double; PDF p. 9, plain bearing DIN 808 joints 45 deg single, 90 deg double; PDF p. 6, plain T series sizes 50 and up 30 deg (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); Timken NB10-UJ needle bearing type, max operating angle for power transmission 25 deg (https://cad.timken.com/printitem/needle-bearing-type-universal-joints/eedle-bearing-type-universal-solid-joints-imperial/68514415607). requirements.name: ハンドルから車輪の側へ伝わる回転のむらの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the example value of an allowable torque variation rate in a passenger-car steering design tool, applied to this vehicle. NSK Ltd, US 8,965,743 B2 (granted 2015-02-24), description of FIG. 21-27: the allowable torque variation rate is "for example, 10%" (FIG. 23-27 compare 10 % down to 3 %); the torque variation rate is the ratio of input to output torque, the inverse of the angular velocity ratio (its Equation (5) is an image and was not read); read 2026-11-06 in the Google Patents text (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). HIRAKU takes the rate as the largest deviation of the output-to-input speed ratio from 1 over one turn (an assumption about the patent's definition). The ratio of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a) (a = angle between the shafts, t = turn of the input from the position where its arm of the cross lies in the plane of the two shafts), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary) (https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); the same range w cos a to w sec a in Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. criterion.basis: H1: no two bodies overlap at rest, the driver's seat at either end of its slide too, beyond what the rule allows (welded joints, bolted mounts up to MOUNT_MM, the rest TOUCH_MM: k4_geometry.model.allowance)

criterion.basis: H1: every mechanical joint a part's connects_to names touches (gap at most 2 mm: the program management's figure; wires and hoses not counted), says where (at_mm) on both shapes within 2 mm, and no part is joined to nothing

load_cases.title: 部品と部材がモジュールの空間に収まっているか

load_cases.title: 体格の範囲の両端で座れるか・膝と頭が当たらないか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the knees of a young male 95th percentile (AIST J5 buttock-knee length) clear the part ahead

load_cases.title: 運転者のペダルを踏む膝の角度が、体格の両端で楽な範囲にあるか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the pedal knee of a female 5th and a male 95th percentile, each at their best place in the seat's slide, within 99-138 deg (Porter and Gyi 1998, read in Schmidt et al. 2014; the original not checked)

load_cases.title: どの部品も、どこかの向きから入れられるか

criterion.basis: H5: every part of the design goes in, along some direction in some order (none shut in by what is there before it); the steps without the hands' way and out of reach (steps_without_tool_clearance, steps_out_of_reach) are shown in the results, not judged: the assembly tool's hands' way is its own rule with no source

load_cases.title: 車輪が巻き上げた物 (踏面の、車軸の真上から前 30 度・後ろ 50 度) が乗員に届かないか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H6: no line thrown off the tread above the axle (90 deg ahead of to 90 deg behind straight above it: the requirement is that mud reaches no occupant) reaches an occupant's body part before another part or member. The arc 30 deg ahead to 50 deg behind (Q87, Q88) gives spray_uncovered_arc only: Q87 and Q88 are 道路運送車両の保安基準の細目を定める告示 (2023.9.22 版) 第178条 第2項 第1号 as the intake department read it: a public-road rule for other traffic, borrowed; applying it to the occupants is an assumption. The lines are straight along the tangent the way the tread moves going forward (no gravity, no air, not in reverse), 5 deg apart along the arc, 5 across the tyre, up to 3000 mm: assumptions, not checked

criterion.basis: H7: no fixed member or part in a doorway 450 mm wide (Q93) from the seat top up to the higher of seat top + 985.2 mm (Q95) and floor + 1250 mm (Q96), with 300 mm wide (Q94) from the floor up to the seat top at its front end, at its best place; the opening is looked for beside the seat (outboard of its outer face), from the seat back to the front of the seated person's feet (an assumption). Q93, Q94, Q96: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption); Q95: AIST sitting height I1, young men 95th percentile, as the intake department read it (an assumption). A net held only by quick-release clips and a door with hinges and a latch open (Q47: opened by hand with one hand in one action, CPSC's proposed rule's preamble applied to opening, an assumption) and are not counted

load_cases.title: 地面から最初の足場 (段か床の上面) まで 550 mm 以下 (2 人 + 荷)

Q97: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption)

load_cases.title: 座席の横に、太さ 16〜38 mm で、足場から 1600 mm までの手がかりがある (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H7: beside each side seat at least one member or hand-hold part 16 to 38 mm across (Q49, Q89) within 1600 mm (Q48) over the first surface a foot goes on, outboard of the seat's middle; the opening is looked for beside the seat (outboard of its outer face), from the seat back to the front of the seated person's feet (an assumption). Q48, Q49, Q89: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption). That one is needed at all is an assumption (no source read asks for one under a floor of 1 m)

assumptions: 仮の規則 (出典なし): ペダルの踏む板は、大きい人 (AIST の若年男性 95 パーセンタイル) の右足の母指球の下に置くが、外の端はフレームのレールの外の面で止める (足元は前輪の掃引の内側。設計を作るコードの kit/body.place_pedals)。足がそれより外にあるときも、脚の形は動かさずに板だけ内へ寄せる

仮の規則 (出典なし): 組み立ての手の道 (両手と短い工具が外から留め具まで真っすぐ入る道) は、留める節の部材と、その留め具のそばで終わる部材 (継ぎ目で分かれた隣の部材。手の開き 200 mm (MIL-STD-1472H の図 57 の両手の開口、確かめていない) の半分と部材の太さの内) にはふさがれない。外から腕の届く長さ (AIST 1991-92 の C3、若年女性 5 パーセンタイル 606 mm、k4_geometry.people) より先にある物も、腕が回り込むとみて道をふさがない

頭の後ろの高さ・幅・backset・背もたれとのすき間 (Q35-Q38、UN R17・FMVSS 202a の測り方を受付部が読んだもの) は、次の簡略で測っている: R 点は大きい人 (AIST の m95) の腰の点 (規格は 50 パーセンタイルの男性の H 点。高さは厳しい側に出る)、背もたれは直立 (背の角度 0) なので胴の線に沿う距離は鉛直の距離、上端から 65 mm 下の幅は箱の幅、背もたれとのすき間は上下の隙間 (165 mm の球は再現していない)、backset は大きい人の頭の後ろから頭受けの前の面まで

effects.name: body sizes: AIST anthropometric database 1991-92 (Kouchi and Mochimaru 2005, AIST H16PRO 287), young adults; items I1, D2, J2, J5, J7, J9, I3, I11, I13, C3, C7, C12, C16, D15, D17, M4, M15, M16, M20, M24 read from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html on 2026-11-03

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁) 第 20 条: 縦断勾配 12 % は第 1 項のただし書、14 % は第 4 項の 2 級林道の例外 (the steepest stretch), https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (the article and its paragraphs read for this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁「風の強さと吹き方」https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/know/yougo_hp/kazehyo.html (the table is an image, kazehyo.png and kazehyo.pdf): 平均風速 20 m/s is where 「非常に強い風」 begins; 注 2: the gust is often about 1.5 times the mean wind (3 times or more when the air is unstable). So a gust of 30 m/s (1.5 x 20 m/s) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer, dust and splashing water on a forest road)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 動かして操作する仕組みと配線の隙間の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 dd (mechanical control cables) and 11-125 (movable controls): at least 1/2 in (= 12.7 mm, computed) between wiring and the controls when the bundle is pushed with light hand pressure toward them, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める高さの下限 (座席の基準点から、胴の線に沿って上へ)
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (MLIT English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf), para. 5.6.2 and 5.6.3.1 (front seats not less than 800 mm, other seats 750 mm) and para. 6.5.4 (the height is from the R point, the seating reference point of para. 2.13, to the tangent at the top, measured along the manikin's torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; R17 applies to M1 and N1 (para. 1). 49 CFR 571.202a (FMVSS 202a, eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a) S4.2.1(a)(1) (front outboard not less than 800 mm in at least one position) with S3 (height from the H-point parallel to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; it applies to passenger cars and to MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R25 was not checked (not reachable). No text read requires this for an off-road utility or recreational vehicle; ANSI/ROHVA 1, ANSI/OPEI B71.9 and SAE J2258 were not checked

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める面の左右の幅の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.11 (not less than 85 mm to each side of the seat's vertical median plane; 2 x 85 = 170 mm computed) and para. 6.6.1 (measured in a plane 65 mm below the top, perpendicular to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.2 (not less than 170 mm at 65 ±3 mm below the top; 254 mm for a front outboard seat when a front centre seat exists), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles (S2)

requirements.name: 頭の後ろと、それを受け止める面との前後のすき間の上限

UN R17 08 series has no backset limit (the word does not occur in the MLIT text, read 2026-11-06); later R17 series and UN R25 were not checked

requirements.name: 背もたれと、頭を受け止める部分のあいだのすき間の上限

requirements.name: 操舵の回転を折って伝える所の、1 か所あたりの折れ角の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the maximum operating angle of one maker's single steering universal joints, applied to the joints of this vehicle, whose maker is not chosen. Borgeson Universal, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" (sheet dated 3/20/2018), item 1): single joints 35 degrees, double joints 70 degrees, beyond which the joint can bind and be damaged; read 2026-11-06 (https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). These are aftermarket steering joints of cars. Industrial joints are rated otherwise (read 2026-11-06): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 8, needle roller T series 40 deg single, 80 deg double; PDF p. 9, plain bearing DIN 808 joints 45 deg single, 90 deg double; PDF p. 6, plain T series sizes 50 and up 30 deg (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); Timken NB10-UJ needle bearing type, max operating angle for power transmission 25 deg (https://cad.timken.com/printitem/needle-bearing-type-universal-joints/eedle-bearing-type-universal-solid-joints-imperial/68514415607). Borgeson's web page (https://www.borgeson.com/joints.html) was not checked (403). The joint actually chosen and its catalogue win over this value

requirements.name: ハンドルから車輪の側へ伝わる回転のむらの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the example value of an allowable torque variation rate in a passenger-car steering design tool, applied to this vehicle. NSK Ltd, US 8,965,743 B2 (granted 2015-02-24), description of FIG. 21-27: the allowable torque variation rate is "for example, 10%" (FIG. 23-27 compare 10 % down to 3 %); the torque variation rate is the ratio of input to output torque, the inverse of the angular velocity ratio (its Equation (5) is an image and was not read); read 2026-11-06 in the Google Patents text (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). HIRAKU takes the rate as the largest deviation of the output-to-input speed ratio from 1 over one turn (an assumption about the patent's definition). The ratio of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a) (a = angle between the shafts, t = turn of the input from the position where its arm of the cross lies in the plane of the two shafts), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary) (https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); the same range w cos a to w sec a in Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. No standard for steering was read

load_cases.title: 横転したときの乗員の空間: ロールバーを横・後ろから押してエネルギーを吸わせ、上から押しつぶし、どの押し方でも乗員の空間に入らないか (OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる、2 人 + 荷)
load_cases.basis: 押す量は Q86 の基準の質量 M に OECD Standard Code 4 (2026-02) 3.5.2.1・3.5.3.1・3.6.1 の係数 (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N) を掛けたもので、同じ実行の R4 の荷重条件 (R4 builder が Q86 から出した値) から写した。Code 4 は 600 kg 以上のトラクタの規格で、この車に借りるのは仮定。後ろの力の位置 rear_fraction (上の梁の幅の 1/6) も R4 と同じ。限度は Code 4 3.5.2.2・3.5.3.2・3.8 の「どの押し方でも構造が乗員の空間 (k4_geometry.occupant_spaces、AIST の若年男性 95 % で広げた箱) に入らない」で、距離 0 mm 以上 (式の 0 * rollbar_t は、限度 0 に長さの単位を持たせるためだけのもので、ロールバーの肉厚には意味を持たせていない)。押し方は 1 つずつ組んだままの枠から (前の押し方の残りの変形を持ち越さない。Code 4 は順に押す)。横・後ろ・上は 1 つの荷重条件にまとめ、判定は 3 つのうち最も小さい距離 (式 frame_static.rops_occupant_clearance と同じ)。C3 を解くツールは棚にまだ無い (R4 の rollover_beam は落とす動的な解析で、試験 R4 だけ)。

text: C3 の荷重条件 C3-side875J「横転したときの乗員の空間: ロールバーを横・後ろから押してエネルギーを吸わせ、上から押しつぶし、どの押し方でも乗員の空間に入らないか (OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる、2 人 + 荷)」を書きました。限度は rops_occupant_clearance >= 0 mm (0 * t 2.3 mm)。根拠: 押す量は Q86 の基準の質量 M に OECD Standard Code 4 (2026-02) 3.5.2.1・3.5.3.1・3.6.1 の係数 (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N) を掛けたもので、同じ実行の R4 の荷重条件 (R4 builder が Q86 から出した値) から写した。Code 4 は 600 kg 以上のトラクタの規格で、この車に借りるのは仮定。後ろの力の位置 rear_fraction (上の梁の幅の 1/6) も R4 と同じ。限度は Code 4 3.5.2.2・3.5.3.2・3.8 の「どの押し方でも構造が乗員の空間 (k4_geometry.occupant_spaces、AIST の若年男性 95 % で広げた箱) に入らない」で、距離 0 mm 以上 (式の 0 * rollbar_t は、限度 0 に長さの単位を持たせるためだけのもので、ロールバーの肉厚には意味を持たせていない)。押し方は 1 つずつ組んだままの枠から (前の押し方の残りの変形を持ち越さない。Code 4 は順に押す)。横・後ろ・上は 1 つの荷重条件にまとめ、判定は 3 つのうち最も小さい距離 (式 frame_static.rops_occupant_clearance と同じ)。C3 を解くツールは棚にまだ無い (R4 の rollover_beam は落とす動的な解析で、試験 R4 だけ)。

data.summary: まだ判定していない試験: C1-40kmh、C1-split、C3-side875J

text: modal は段 1 (軽い計算)のツールなので、N1-40kmh の解析は止めました。v1 で、それより軽い段の荷重条件にNG か未判定が残っています:H1-interference (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、OK にできない: 予測と比べた結果 cmp-0001 の不一致 (+100 %) の原因がまだ書かれていない、解析 ana-0001 (assembly) の interference_count が 2 で、基準 ≤ 0 を超えている)、H1-motion (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H1-joints (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H1-envelope (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H1-steer (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H3-body-size (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H3-knee-angle (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H5-order (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H6-spray (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H7-opening (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H7-step (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)、H7-handhold (段 0 (レイアウトと規則)、未判定)。軽い段から確かめてください: 未判定のものは予測 → analyze → compare で判定を付けます。同じ段のツールは並べて回してかまいません

data.want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両を作りたい。電池で走る 4 輪で、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg。横転しても、乗っている人を守りたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁) 第 20 条: 縦断勾配 12 % は第 1 項のただし書、14 % は第 4 項の 2 級林道の例外 (the steepest stretch), https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (the article and its paragraphs read for this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁「風の強さと吹き方」https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/kishou/know/yougo_hp/kazehyo.html (the table is an image, kazehyo.png and kazehyo.pdf): 平均風速 20 m/s is where 「非常に強い風」 begins; 注 2: the gust is often about 1.5 times the mean wind (3 times or more when the air is unstable). So a gust of 30 m/s (1.5 x 20 m/s) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer, dust and splashing water on a forest road)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 動かして操作する仕組みと配線の隙間の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 dd (mechanical control cables) and 11-125 (movable controls): at least 1/2 in (= 12.7 mm, computed) between wiring and the controls when the bundle is pushed with light hand pressure toward them, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf

requirements.name: 人数と荷重の組 (見る組)
requirements.basis: request (2 人乗り、積載 150 kg)
requirements.note: MVP は two_cargo (2 人 + 荷) だけを見る。empty・driver・two はまだ見ない。乗員と荷は設計の部品 (kind occupant / cargo)

requirements.name: 体格の範囲
requirements.value: 若年女性 5 % 〜 若年男性 95 %
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 B1 身長, 若年 (young adults), パーセンタイル 5 % の女性 1511.2 mm から 95 % の男性 1819.6 mm, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (B1 table read 2026-11-06)

requirements.name: 体重 (強さの不利側)
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 N1 体重, 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (N1 table read 2026-11-06)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める高さの下限 (座席の基準点から、胴の線に沿って上へ)
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (MLIT English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf), para. 5.6.2 and 5.6.3.1 (front seats not less than 800 mm, other seats 750 mm) and para. 6.5.4 (the height is from the R point, the seating reference point of para. 2.13, to the tangent at the top, measured along the manikin's torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; R17 applies to M1 and N1 (para. 1). 49 CFR 571.202a (FMVSS 202a, eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a) S4.2.1(a)(1) (front outboard not less than 800 mm in at least one position) with S3 (height from the H-point parallel to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06; it applies to passenger cars and to MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R25 was not checked (not reachable). No text read requires this for an off-road utility or recreational vehicle; ANSI/ROHVA 1, ANSI/OPEI B71.9 and SAE J2258 were not checked

requirements.name: 頭を後ろから受け止める面の左右の幅の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.11 (not less than 85 mm to each side of the seat's vertical median plane; 2 x 85 = 170 mm computed) and para. 6.6.1 (measured in a plane 65 mm below the top, perpendicular to the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.2 (not less than 170 mm at 65 ±3 mm below the top; 254 mm for a front outboard seat when a front centre seat exists), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles (S2)

requirements.name: 頭の後ろと、それを受け止める面との前後のすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a US passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.3 (front outboard backset not more than 55 mm) with S3 (backset = the minimum horizontal distance from the rear of the head of a seated 50th percentile male, head restraint measurement device on the SAE J826 manikin, to the head restraint) and S5.2.3 (top set between 750 and 800 mm, seat back at the design angle), eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a, read 2026-11-06; applies to passenger cars and MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less (S2). UN R17 08 series has no backset limit (the word does not occur in the MLIT text, read 2026-11-06); later R17 series and UN R25 were not checked

requirements.name: 背もたれと、頭を受け止める部分のあいだのすき間の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.8 (no gap of more than 60 mm between the seat back and a head restraint not adjustable for height; 25 mm in the lowest position if adjustable) and para. 6.7.1 (gaps measured with a 165 mm sphere), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.4.1 (no gap greater than 60 mm with a 165 mm sphere), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: request
requirements.note: 乗員とは別の荷として扱う (聞いていない)

requirements.name: 荷の重心の高さ (荷台の床から)
requirements.basis: the demo design's cargo: its box centre at 600 mm stands 150 mm above the deck's top at 450 mm (data/designs/offroad-4w-v1.json, parts cargo and deck)

requirements.name: 足を置く面どうしの高さの差の上限 (段と段、最後の段から床まで)
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (between steps max 300 mm; last step to door sill max 300 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 B (riser 230 to 400 mm, basic 300 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の幅の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (width of step min 150 mm; footnote: for practical reasons not less than 250 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 C (one foot 160 mm min, both feet 320 mm min), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の外の縁から先の、つま先が入る空きの下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (clearance from the outside edge of the step min 150 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 F2 (toe clearance min 150 mm, basic 200 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 開口を、乗る人が道具なしに片手・一つの動作で開けられること
requirements.basis: assumption. CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, preamble (occupant retention), read 2026-11-04, accepts a barrier the occupant puts in place with one hand in one operation, such as a door (said of closing; applied here to opening). 道路運送車両の保安基準 第25条第3項, read 2026-11-04: 鎖・ロープなど転落を防ぐ装置は扉の代わりになる. No force or time for opening was found

requirements.name: 乗り降りの手がかりの高さの上限 (足を置く面から上へ)
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.8 (grab rails begin at max 1 600 mm above the ground or platform; continue to at least 900 mm above the last step), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 D, not checked here. an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read). Whether a hand hold is required at all for a floor below 1 m was not found in any source read (ISO 2867:1994 4.7 asks for three-point support above 1 m)

requirements.name: 手でつかむ所の太さ (直径か平行な面の間) の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.3 (grab rail or handle: 16 mm min, 25 mm recommended, 38 mm max), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 A (16 mm min, 38 mm max, 25 mm basic), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.basis: request

requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 第3号's table, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf (the 2021.6.9 text): the row for a maximum speed of 35 km/h or more and under 80 km/h (initial speed 35 km/h, stopping distance 14 m or less), a borrowing and not a row for this vehicle's kind (the same table's row for 20 km/h or more and under 35 km/h: initial speed 20 km/h, 5 m or less) (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 第5号, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf (the 2021.6.9 text): 「5 分の 1 こう配」 (20 %), not a requirement for this vehicle's kind (read 2026-11-05)

requirements.name: 操舵の回転を折って伝える所の、1 か所あたりの折れ角の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the maximum operating angle of one maker's single steering universal joints, applied to the joints of this vehicle, whose maker is not chosen. Borgeson Universal, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" (sheet dated 3/20/2018), item 1): single joints 35 degrees, double joints 70 degrees, beyond which the joint can bind and be damaged; read 2026-11-06 (https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). These are aftermarket steering joints of cars. Industrial joints are rated otherwise (read 2026-11-06): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 8, needle roller T series 40 deg single, 80 deg double; PDF p. 9, plain bearing DIN 808 joints 45 deg single, 90 deg double; PDF p. 6, plain T series sizes 50 and up 30 deg (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); Timken NB10-UJ needle bearing type, max operating angle for power transmission 25 deg (https://cad.timken.com/printitem/needle-bearing-type-universal-joints/eedle-bearing-type-universal-solid-joints-imperial/68514415607). Borgeson's web page (https://www.borgeson.com/joints.html) was not checked (403). The joint actually chosen and its catalogue win over this value

requirements.name: ハンドルから車輪の側へ伝わる回転のむらの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the example value of an allowable torque variation rate in a passenger-car steering design tool, applied to this vehicle. NSK Ltd, US 8,965,743 B2 (granted 2015-02-24), description of FIG. 21-27: the allowable torque variation rate is "for example, 10%" (FIG. 23-27 compare 10 % down to 3 %); the torque variation rate is the ratio of input to output torque, the inverse of the angular velocity ratio (its Equation (5) is an image and was not read); read 2026-11-06 in the Google Patents text (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). HIRAKU takes the rate as the largest deviation of the output-to-input speed ratio from 1 over one turn (an assumption about the patent's definition). The ratio of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a) (a = angle between the shafts, t = turn of the input from the position where its arm of the cross lies in the plane of the two shafts), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary) (https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); the same range w cos a to w sec a in Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. No standard for steering was read

load_cases.title: 土の地面で横転: 傾斜台を倒れる角度より先まで傾けて車を床に落とし、ロールバーと骨組みが乗員の空間に入らないか (HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない。手計算は OECD Code 4 の静的試験の形を借りる: 横 875 J・後ろ 700 J・上 10 kN、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: R4: in a rollover (the tilt table past the angle the vehicle tips at; it falls onto the floor and lands on its roll bar) no frame member enters the occupants' space; the smallest gap over the landing between the frame's members (the roll bar and the rest) and the space of k4_geometry.occupant_spaces (the occupant box, widened to AIST D2 and raised to AIST I1 of a young male 95th percentile) stays at 0 mm or more. HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない. OECD Code 4 (2.1: tractors of at least 600 kg, as read on 2026-11-03, the 600 kg not in README's table of checked values) and ISO 3471 (about 700 kg and up: 確かめていない) are static tests for machines of 600-700 kg and up; whether ANSI/ROHVA 1 has a dynamic test was not checked. Code 4 (3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2) stops its static loading at the same space; its loads are the hand calculation's, and R4's 10 kN from above (Code 4's 20 N/kg at the reference mass 500 kg gives 10 kN) is 「HIRAKU の仮定」. The ground is a soil: 1000 N/mm per contact point (地面の硬さは HIRAKU の仮定。土と舗装の 2 通り; R4-rollover-pavement is the same on a pavement)

HIRAKU 独自の計算の確かめ。規格の試験ではない. OECD Code 4 (2.1: tractors of at least 600 kg, as read on 2026-11-03, the 600 kg not in README's table of checked values) and ISO 3471 (about 700 kg and up: 確かめていない) are static tests for machines of 600-700 kg and up; whether ANSI/ROHVA 1 has a dynamic test was not checked. Code 4 (3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2) stops its static loading at the same space; its loads are the hand calculation's, and R4's 10 kN from above (Code 4's 20 N/kg at the reference mass 500 kg gives 10 kN) is 「HIRAKU の仮定」. criterion.basis: T2: the design variable controller_max_temperature (the part's limit; its source is in the design generator), against the lumped temperature of the part

load_cases.title: 止まっているときの干渉 (座席を滑りの両端に動かしたときも)

criterion.basis: H1: no two bodies overlap at rest, the driver's seat at either end of its slide too, beyond what the rule allows (welded joints, bolted mounts up to MOUNT_MM, the rest TOUCH_MM: k4_geometry.model.allowance)

load_cases.title: 車輪が上下しハンドルを切ったときの干渉

criterion.basis: H1: through the wheels' travel and the steering's range nothing of a corner meets what it is not mounted to

load_cases.title: つながりが形の上で触れているか (つながる点 at_mm が両方の形の上、つながりの無い部品が無い)

criterion.basis: H1: every mechanical joint a part's connects_to names touches (gap at most 2 mm: the program management's figure; wires and hoses not counted), says where (at_mm) on both shapes within 2 mm, and no part is joined to nothing

load_cases.title: 部品と部材がモジュールの空間に収まっているか

criterion.basis: H1: every part and member inside its module's space (design.modules envelope, given by the packager)

load_cases.title: ハンドルを止めまで切れるか (前輪がフレームに当たらない)

criterion.basis: H1: the front wheels turn to the design's max_steer_angle (30 deg) without touching the frame

load_cases.title: 体格の範囲の両端で座れるか・膝と頭が当たらないか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the knees of a young male 95th percentile (AIST J5 buttock-knee length) clear the part ahead

load_cases.title: 運転者のペダルを踏む膝の角度が、体格の両端で楽な範囲にあるか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the pedal knee of a female 5th and a male 95th percentile, each at their best place in the seat's slide, within 99-138 deg (Porter and Gyi 1998, read in Schmidt et al. 2014; the original not checked)

load_cases.title: どの部品も、どこかの向きから入れられるか

criterion.basis: H5: every part of the design goes in, along some direction in some order (none shut in by what is there before it); the steps without the hands' way and out of reach (steps_without_tool_clearance, steps_out_of_reach) are shown in the results, not judged: the assembly tool's hands' way is its own rule with no source

load_cases.title: 車輪が巻き上げた物 (踏面の、車軸の真上から前 30 度・後ろ 50 度) が乗員に届かないか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H6: no line thrown off the tread above the axle (90 deg ahead of to 90 deg behind straight above it: the requirement is that mud reaches no occupant) reaches an occupant's body part before another part or member. The arc 30 deg ahead to 50 deg behind (Q87, Q88) gives spray_uncovered_arc only: Q87 and Q88 are 道路運送車両の保安基準の細目を定める告示 (2023.9.22 版) 第178条 第2項 第1号 as the intake department read it: a public-road rule for other traffic, borrowed; applying it to the occupants is an assumption. The lines are straight along the tangent the way the tread moves going forward (no gravity, no air, not in reverse), 5 deg apart along the arc, 5 across the tyre, up to 3000 mm: assumptions, not checked

load_cases.title: 座席の横に、座面から上へ幅 450 mm・床から座面まで幅 300 mm、座面から 985.2 mm・床から 1250 mm の開口があり、動かない物でふさがっていない (開けられる網・扉は数えない (Q47)、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H7: no fixed member or part in a doorway 450 mm wide (Q93) from the seat top up to the higher of seat top + 985.2 mm (Q95) and floor + 1250 mm (Q96), with 300 mm wide (Q94) from the floor up to the seat top at its front end, at its best place; the opening is looked for beside the seat (outboard of its outer face), from the seat back to the front of the seated person's feet (an assumption). Q93, Q94, Q96: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption); Q95: AIST sitting height I1, young men 95th percentile, as the intake department read it (an assumption). A net held only by quick-release clips and a door with hinges and a latch open (Q47: opened by hand with one hand in one action, CPSC's proposed rule's preamble applied to opening, an assumption) and are not counted

load_cases.title: 地面から最初の足場 (段か床の上面) まで 550 mm 以下 (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H7: the first surface a foot goes on (a step beside the seat, else the floor's top) at most 550 mm (Q97) over the ground (the lowest tyre bottom). Q97: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption)

load_cases.title: 座席の横に、太さ 16〜38 mm で、足場から 1600 mm までの手がかりがある (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H7: beside each side seat at least one member or hand-hold part 16 to 38 mm across (Q49, Q89) within 1600 mm (Q48) over the first surface a foot goes on, outboard of the seat's middle; the opening is looked for beside the seat (outboard of its outer face), from the seat back to the front of the seated person's feet (an assumption). Q48, Q49, Q89: the intake department's reading of ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 and Table 1 and ISO 2867:1980 / 1994 (older editions of standards for agricultural tractors and earth-moving machinery), borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption). That one is needed at all is an assumption (no source read asks for one under a floor of 1 m)

criterion.basis: min(y_tube 245 MPa, y_mech 215 MPa) / Q61 1.5 (materials stkr400, stkm13a: not checked)

load_cases.basis: 押す量は Q86 の基準の質量 M に OECD Standard Code 4 (2026-02) 3.5.2.1・3.5.3.1・3.6.1 の係数 (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N) を掛けたもので、同じ実行の R4 の荷重条件 (R4 builder が Q86 から出した値) から写した。Code 4 は 600 kg 以上のトラクタの規格で、この車に借りるのは仮定。後ろの力の位置 rear_fraction (上の梁の幅の 1/6) も R4 と同じ。限度は Code 4 3.5.2.2・3.5.3.2・3.8 の「どの押し方でも構造が乗員の空間 (k4_geometry.occupant_spaces、AIST の若年男性 95 % で広げた箱) に入らない」で、距離 0 mm 以上 (式の 0 * rollbar_t は、限度 0 に長さの単位を持たせるためだけのもので、ロールバーの肉厚には意味を持たせていない)。押し方は 1 つずつ組んだままの枠から (前の押し方の残りの変形を持ち越さない。Code 4 は順に押す)。横・後ろ・上は 1 つの荷重条件にまとめ、判定は 3 つのうち最も小さい距離 (式 frame_static.rops_occupant_clearance と同じ)。C3 を解くツールは棚にまだ無い (R4 の rollover_beam は落とす動的な解析で、試験 R4 だけ)。

assumptions: formula_inputs (analysis.h1_motion_calc) の値
動くのは車輪とタイロッドだけ
only the wheels and the tie rods move (the tool also moves the knuckle, the brake and the other links of the corner)
the wheel turns about the vertical axis through the support's position, through -max_steer_angle to +max_steer_angle; it moves up and down by half the travel each way
the other bodies as in assembly.overlap_count (turned parts and slanted members left out); what is mounted to the moving part is the tool's rule (k4_geometry.model.mounted)
formula_inputs (analysis.h1_joint_calc) の値
箱どうしの離れで測る
the gap between the axis-aligned boxes round the two (a node's or a support's point for those): never more than the gap between the shapes, so a joint can be missed, never added
a joint touches when the gap is at most 2 mm; wires and hoses run between the two and are not counted
formula_inputs (analysis.h1_envelope_calc) の値
each body as the axis-aligned box round it (turned parts round their turned corners, slanted members round their ends widened by half the section's largest side)
inside means inside one box of the envelope, more than 0.5 mm out counts

data.expression: w cos(theta) + l sin(theta) - w = c  ->  theta = asin((w + c) / sqrt(w^2 + l^2)) - atan2(w, l)
assumptions: formula_inputs (analysis.h1_calc) の値
車輪は上から見て長方形、中心の縦の軸で回る
the wheel is a rectangle in plan view (diameter x width)
it turns about the vertical axis through its centre
the frame face beside it runs along x
formula_inputs (analysis.h3_calc) の値
背もたれに付けて座る、AIST J5 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル
the person sits against the seat back
thighs level, along x

data.expression: d(theta) = sqrt(l1^2 + l2^2 - 2 l1 l2 cos theta); for each body size: min(d(theta) - d(theta_lo), d(theta_hi) - d(theta)); room = the smaller of the two
assumptions: formula_inputs (analysis.h3_knee_calc) の値
脚は膝で曲がる 2 本の棒
the leg is two straight links hinged at the knee (side view); the hip-ankle distance grows with the knee angle, so a margin is negative exactly when the angle is out of the range
the knee angles are those of K4's seated poses (each person at their best place in the seat's slide): not an independent estimate of the angle, only of its margin
式のほかの出力 (予測にしていないもの): room_big 24.2 mm、room_small -49.29 mm
formula_inputs (analysis.h5_calc) の値
部品を止めるのは枠だけ、先に入れた部品は数えない

only the frame stops a part: its members and the welded pieces (kinds frame, gusset, rollbar, bracket), there before any part; parts put in earlier are not counted (the tool also tries orders, and slides a part first)
a part goes straight along one axis; a piece already overlapping it at rest is H1-interference's and does not stop it
boxes as in assembly.overlap_count; turned parts are not counted
theta_free は pred-0010 の値
theta_stop は設計の変数 max_steer_angle (formula_inputs)
the steering stops at theta_stop: the wheel is not turned further, so the angle checked is not larger than it

assumptions: 仮の規則 (出典なし): ペダルの踏む板は、大きい人 (AIST の若年男性 95 パーセンタイル) の右足の母指球の下に置くが、外の端はフレームのレールの外の面で止める (足元は前輪の掃引の内側。設計を作るコードの kit/body.place_pedals)。足がそれより外にあるときも、脚の形は動かさずに板だけ内へ寄せる

仮の規則 (出典なし): 組み立ての手の道 (両手と短い工具が外から留め具まで真っすぐ入る道) は、留める節の部材と、その留め具のそばで終わる部材 (継ぎ目で分かれた隣の部材。手の開き 200 mm (MIL-STD-1472H の図 57 の両手の開口、確かめていない) の半分と部材の太さの内) にはふさがれない。外から腕の届く長さ (AIST 1991-92 の C3、若年女性 5 パーセンタイル 606 mm、k4_geometry.people) より先にある物も、腕が回り込むとみて道をふさがない

頭の後ろの高さ・幅・backset・背もたれとのすき間 (Q35-Q38、UN R17・FMVSS 202a の測り方を受付部が読んだもの) は、次の簡略で測っている: R 点は大きい人 (AIST の m95) の腰の点 (規格は 50 パーセンタイルの男性の H 点。高さは厳しい側に出る)、背もたれは直立 (背の角度 0) なので胴の線に沿う距離は鉛直の距離、上端から 65 mm 下の幅は箱の幅、背もたれとのすき間は上下の隙間 (165 mm の球は再現していない)、backset は大きい人の頭の後ろから頭受けの前の面まで

effects.name: body sizes: AIST anthropometric database 1991-92 (Kouchi and Mochimaru 2005, AIST H16PRO 287), young adults; items I1, D2, J2, J5, J7, J9, I3, I11, I13, C3, C7, C12, C16, D15, D17, M4, M15, M16, M20, M24 read from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html on 2026-11-03

knee_angle_room (mm of the hip-ankle distance): knee angle 99-138 deg: Porter and Gyi 1998 (IJVD 19(3) 255-266), read in Schmidt et al. 2014, Applied Ergonomics 45 247-260, Table 1 p. 251; the original not verified
